name: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) Preliminaries
definition: Scene representation using a set of 3D points with anisotropic Gaussian extent as a proxy for geometry, where each Gaussian is cut at 3σ to form ellipsoid-shaped splats.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting is a scene representation method that replaces implicit neural fields with explicit anisotropic Gaussian primitives, enabling real-time GPU rasterization without ray marching.
